Container.Name: ComfyUI-Nvidia-Docker
Container.Overview:
ComfyUI (Stable Diffusion WebUI) on Tower06's Tesla V100-SXM2-16GB. Image-generation stack migrated here from the Tower03 5060 Ti so both 5060 Ti cards are free for the Tower03 "brain" session.
Host-specific notes for this deployment: - GPU pinned to the V100 (NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES UUID below). - COMFY_CMDLINE_EXTRA = "--lowvram --cache-lru 0". --lowvram keeps the text encoders off the 16 GB of VRAM so SDXL/Flux-class models fit on the V100 (same card size as the old 5060 Ti). --cache-lru 0 uses dynamic VRAM. - DISABLE_UPGRADES = true: the venv is fixed at a known-good set (torch 2.7.1+cu126, which has sm_70/Volta kernels AND supports comfy_kitchen). Do NOT let the container pip-upgrade on start, or it pulls a cu129 torch with no sm_70 and the V100 throws cudaErrorNoKernelImageForDevice. Update ComfyUI via the Manager only. - Run dir, basedir, input and output all live on the cache_ssd SSD (ai-models share).
The "run directory" contains HF, ComfyUI and venv. The "basedir" contains input, output and custom_nodes. The ComfyUI Manager is installed to add custom nodes and update ComfyUI.
Container.Requires: **Nvidia Driver plugin**. Tesla V100 (Volta, sm_70) requires a torch build with sm_70 kernels; this template pins the venv via DISABLE_UPGRADES=true — see Overview.

Config.Name: WANTED_UID
Config.Description: UID to use for content in run directory

Config.Name: WANTED_GID
Config.Description: GID to use for content in run directory

Config.Name: ENABLE_MANAGER_LEGACY_UI
Config.Description: Enable legacy UI for ComfyUI Manager

Config.Name: COMFY_CMDLINE_EXTRA
Config.Description: Extra command-line options for ComfyUI. --lowvram keeps text encoders off the V100's 16GB VRAM; --cache-lru 0 uses dynamic VRAM.

Config.Name: SECURITY_LEVEL
Config.Description: Modify the security level for the WebUI, see https://github.com/ltdrdata/ComfyUI-Manager?tab=readme-ov-file#security-policy for authorized values

Config.Name: FORCE_CHOWN
Config.Description: Force change directory ownership as the comfy user during script startup (this process might be slow). Enabled by default on Unraid.

Config.Name: DISABLE_UPGRADES
Config.Description: Disable container-start upgrades of python packages (also disables USE_PIPUPGRADE). KEEP TRUE on the V100: upgrades pull a cu129 torch with no sm_70 kernels and break generation. Update ComfyUI via the Manager only.

Config.Name: USE_PIPUPGRADE
Config.Description: new default is to use pip install --upgrade, set to false to use pip install. (No effect while DISABLE_UPGRADES=true.)

Config.Name: USE_SOCAT
Config.Description: Use socat to listen on port 8188 and forward to 127.0.0.1:8181 (ie use an alternate port for Comfy to run)

Config.Name: BASE_DIRECTORY
Config.Description: Base directory for ComfyUI user directories such as models, input, output and custom_nodes

Config.Name: NETWORK_MODE
Config.Description: Required to be set to personal_cloud to allow custom nodes installation
